1	# WP-008: GUI Settings Credentials Section
     2	
     3	## Plan Context
     4	
     5	Extend the Git credentials system from a single-token-per-host model to a multi-credential model with per-repository credential association, auto-selection for single-match hosts, and clear error surfacing for missing credentials.
     6	
     7	## Description
     8	
     9	Update the credentials section in the GUI settings view to support the new array-based credential model. This includes the updated table layout, new add form with label field, inline editing, updated delete flow with repository-reference warnings, and updated API client methods.
    10	
    11	## Scope
    12	
    13	- `gui/public/js/views/settings.js` — updated `buildCredentialsSection()`, `renderCredentialsTable()`, add form, inline edit, delete confirmation with repository-reference check
    14	- `gui/public/js/api.js` — renamed `api.config.credentials.set()` → `api.config.credentials.add()`, new `api.config.credentials.update(id, data)`, updated `api.config.credentials.remove(id)` to delete by ID
    15	- `gui/public/js/views/settings.test.mjs` — updated tests for new table columns, label field, inline edit, deletion warning
    16	- `gui/public/js/api.config.test.mjs` — tests for renamed/new credential API client methods
    17	
    18	## Deliverables
    19	
    20	- Credentials table columns changed from [Host, Token, Actions] to [Label, Host, Token, Actions]
    21	- Add credential form includes a required "Label" field; button text changed to "Add Credential"
    22	- Inline edit: "Edit" button per credential row switches Label cell to `<input>`, shows Token `<input type="password">`, Host is read-only; "Save" calls `PUT /api/config/credentials` with existing `id`
    23	- Delete by credential `id` instead of host
    24	- Deletion confirmation dialog checks `GET /api/repositories` for repositories referencing the credential and includes affected-repository count in the warning message
    25	- API client methods: `api.config.credentials.add()`, `api.config.credentials.update(id, data)`, `api.config.credentials.remove(id)` with updated JSDoc
    26	- GUI tests covering all new behaviours
    27	
    28	## Dependencies
    29	
    30	- WP-005
    31	
    32	## Acceptance Criteria
    33	
    34	1. The credentials table in settings renders columns: Label, Host, Token, Actions.
    35	2. The add credential form includes a required "Label" field, with Host and Token fields, and button text "Add Credential".
    36	3. Clicking "Edit" on a credential row enables inline editing of Label and Token fields; Host is read-only.
    37	4. Clicking "Save" after inline editing calls `PUT /api/config/credentials` with the existing credential `id` and updated fields.
    38	5. Delete button calls `DELETE /api/config/credentials/:id` (by credential `id`, not host).
    39	6. When deleting a credential referenced by repositories, the confirmation dialog warns: _"Remove credential '{label}'? {N} repository/repositories currently use this credential and will lose their credential association."_
    40	7. When deleting a credential not referenced by any repository, the confirmation dialog shows: _"Remove credential '{label}' for host '{host}'? This action cannot be undone."_
    41	8. `api.config.credentials.add()` sends `PUT /api/config/credentials` with the correct body (no `id`).
    42	9. `api.config.credentials.update(id, data)` sends `PUT /api/config/credentials` with the existing `id` in the body.
    43	10. `api.config.credentials.remove(id)` sends `DELETE /api/config/credentials/:id`.
    44	11. All GUI tests in `settings.test.mjs` and `api.config.test.mjs` pass.
    45	
    46	## Active Pipeline Stages
    47	
    48	`implementation` → `qa` → `code-review` → `documentation`
    49	
    50	## Estimated Complexity
    51	
    52	High
    53	
    54	## Rationale
    55	
    56	Bundling the deletion warning (plan Step 13) with the settings section update avoids creating a trivially small standalone WP for a feature that modifies the same file and UI component. The inline edit pattern follows the existing inline-edit pattern used in the repositories table in `repositories.js`.
    57	
    58	## Notes
    59	
    60	Depends on WP-005 (REST API credential endpoints must exist for the API client to call). The `renderCredentialsTable()` function iterates over the array instead of `Object.entries()`. The deletion warning requires fetching the repository list to check for references — this is a `GET /api/repositories` call, not a new endpoint.
